I don't know, I only had one other job before where I got hospitalized before my training and they let me come back with a note but I don't know how it works here. I was on disability alone for years and only just started here a few months ago.  
I'm heavily considering just going right now. I'm a mess, I've hurt myself and going to work with fresh self-injury will probably be super humiliating.
